faq.question: What services do you offer?
faq.answer: We offer three main services: AI-powered website development, AI business automation (including appointment booking, customer inquiry handling, email automation, and workflow automation), and AI-powered analytics & reporting with dashboards and data visualization.

faq.question: What types of businesses do you work with?
faq.answer: We work with a variety of businesses including restaurants, dental and medical clinics, veterinary clinics, retail stores, real estate agencies, construction companies, schools, professional services, and small businesses in general. Each solution is tailored to the specific needs of the business.

faq.question: How long does a typical project take?
faq.answer: Project timelines vary based on scope and complexity. A simple website may take 2-4 weeks, while automation projects typically range from 3-6 weeks. During our initial consultation, we'll provide a realistic timeline based on your specific requirements.

faq.question: Can you improve my existing website?
faq.answer: Yes, we can assess your current website and recommend improvements for design, performance, mobile responsiveness, SEO, or content management. We can work with existing platforms or rebuild if that's the better option.

faq.question: Can AI work with my current business processes?
faq.answer: In most cases, yes. We evaluate your existing workflows and identify where AI and automation can be integrated without disrupting your current operations. Our goal is to enhance your processes, not replace what's already working well.

faq.question: Do you provide support after launch?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer post-launch support to ensure everything runs smoothly. We can also discuss ongoing maintenance plans or future enhancements based on your evolving business needs.
